perItemFindings.label: S3
perItemFindings.one_line: Its claimed absence of Weyl/variational singular-value substrate is stale: clean Causalean declarations `Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.abs_singularValues_add_sub_singularValues_le_opNorm` (and its ContinuousLinearMap form) exactly prove the stated Weyl bound, while `least_singularValue_mul_norm_le` supplies the injective rectangular least-singular-value expansion bound.

verbatim_critique: Re-plan S3 and spectral consumers to reuse `Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.SingularValueWeyl` and `Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.RectangularSignalSingularValues` for Weyl and the variational lower bound; retain local work only for the genuinely uncovered SVD/pseudoinverse portions. The sole declared reuse, `borelMeasurable_compact_argmin_selector`, is a clean 0-sorry total fit after the recorded finite-dimensional carrier transport; the Le Cam, product-KL, Hoeffding, and Pi-transport reuses also fit their stated worlds.
